_comment: Tuned parameters for my_model_v2 (MLB), produced by pipeline.backtest over the 2026 season. Deep-merges over the factory defaults in pipeline/models/config.py. v1 (my_model) is unaffected — it never reads nb_dispersion or park_factors, and it keeps the my_model.md totals thresholds. Regenerate/retune whenever the backtest window changes. Usage: python3 -m pipeline.backtest --sport MLB --model my_model_v2 --config configs/mlb_v2.json
